# sdkwork-commerce-rpc-proto

Compiles canonical commerce RPC protobuf contracts into tonic/prost Rust modules.

Proto sources:

- `packages/common/commerce/sdkwork-commerce-rpc-contracts/proto`
- `../sdkwork-appbase/packages/common/rpc/sdkwork-rpc-contracts/proto` (shared `sdkwork.common.v1` messages)
